content.short: Diffuse combines zkTLS and trusted execution environments for trustless private computation.
content.description: Diffuse is a zkServerless protocol that gives EVM chains access to provable on-chain and off-chain data. The same infrastructure powers a non-custodial lending protocol for structured leverage deals, secured with zero-knowledge proofs and trusted execution environments. The team includes a former p2p.org chief executive and describes more than sixty products launched across eight years in the industry.
content.meta: zkTLS paired with trusted execution, proving a computation without revealing what went into it.
